title: Why do rings form around planets?
angle: Explore the gravitational tipping points and cosmic collisions that turn orbiting debris into stunning planetary rings.
description: An engaging, scientifically accurate exploration into the origin and life cycle of planetary rings. From Édouard Roche's gravitational tipping point to cosmic collisions, cryovolcanic geysers, and shepherd moons, discover how massive celestial bodies transform orbiting debris into shimmering halos across our solar system and beyond.
